environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet within a VPC that has no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoints for any AWS services except ECR (for image pull via PrivateLink), and no internet gateway attached. The subnet route table contains only local VPC CIDR routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local). Logs are written to local ephemeral storage only (/var/log/app.log) with no sidecar, no CloudWatch agent, and no log forwarding mechanism configured. The ECS task role has zero IAM permissions (empty policy document). Security group allows inbound only from internal ALB on port 3000, egress rules deny all traffic (0.0.0.0/0 DENY on all ports).

config.access: inbound from internal ALB only, no SSH/exec access configured
